prior_finding_assessments.rationale: An exhausted, released wrapper now uses the retained target’s stationary strike probe. During the unfinished success animation, generation 1 kept the same target with zero retirements, moves, or displacement. The horse then struck hostile-1 without a fresh proposal, with one modeled Standard per actor. Moving the target out of reach produced one retirement and zero horse attacks.

The new replay samples immediately after the retiring drive and before another engine tick. The wrapper still owned the rider’s Standard slot, had one attack remaining, and reported Unrecorded and Attacking. After B returned to reach, both acts had struck B, the transaction completed, spending stayed at one Standard, and redispatches stayed at zero.
The duplicate checks remain on the continuing out-of-range paths. They repeat work without changing the observed admission or cleanup result. This remains optional.
